Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

To view a patient's visit history, you need to click the 'History' button from the OP service billing screen. This action will bring up a form specifically designed for viewing the patient's visit history. ![Patient Visit History](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114621.png)

You mentioned 'cscan'. How can I assist you further with that?

The 'CScan' function is used to scan cards submitted by patients, such as insurance cards. This feature can be accessed by clicking the 'CScan' button from the OP service billing screen. It allows for the addition of cards submitted by patients through this scanning process. ![CScan](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114335.png)
